title: Spyglass: Officially Launched
summary: We are excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, delivering its powerful new capabilities to all users.

title: Advanced Media Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your images and documents with new controls for uploading, organizing, and customizing how they appear directly within your content.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our dynamic public roadmap to effortlessly track completed features, see what's launching next, and discover our exciting long-term plans for an even better experience.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: Manage your tasks with greater ease thanks to our revitalized checkboxes, now larger, more interactive, and beautifully integrated into our modern design.

title: Seamless Collaborative Editing
summary: Experience more effortless and transparent collaboration with enhanced real-time indicators that keep your team perfectly in sync.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: Easily find and collaborate on all relevant content shared by your connections, making teamwork more intuitive and efficient.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons to welcome a global audience with comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're open-sourcing Noeko's codebase to empower you with greater control, foster direct involvement in our project's growth, and ensure complete transparency in our development journey.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Transform your Constellation view into a dynamic hub for discovery, featuring advanced filtering by tags and time, plus effortless tracking of shared items to supercharge your workflow.

title: Precision Search & Curated Collections
summary: Effortlessly narrow down your knowledge with powerful new filtering, sorting, and the ability to save your custom searches as personalized collections for quick access.

title: Flexible Content Views
summary: This feature empowers you to structure and visualize your notes with dynamic content displays, offering new ways to interact with connected information.

title: Noeko Unlocked: Powerful New Plans & Self-Hosted Options
summary: Get ready to elevate your Noeko experience with powerful new plans that include robust self-hosted options for enhanced control and tailored usage.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Refined Classics
summary: Get ready for a vibrant new look as we refine existing themes and introduce a stunning collection of fresh options to personalize your workspace.

title: Enhanced Time-Aware Welcome
summary: Enjoy a more personalized experience as our homepage greetings will now precisely reflect the current time of day wherever you are.

title: Streamlined Tag Editing
summary: Manage your tagged items with unprecedented ease, allowing you to quickly remove, view, or delete content directly from any tag list.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly integrate insights from a rich variety of content formats, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to centralize and enhance your learning experience.
